description:
JDollar, a solo builder who ships products your grandma can use. 

For NASA Space Apps 2026 I built Flown, a browser game for the Space Mission Design Game challenge: you design a spacecraft to a real mission brief, pin the risks before launch, then fly into failures that really happened, drawn from NASA's own records. 
Skills: game design, TypeScript, React, three.js and space mission history.
